entries.text: I am feeling sluggish because of the cloudy weather . My eyelids feel a bit heavy but the rest of me feels awake . I’m feeling anxious from an interaction with another car I had while driving . He almost hit me when driving around me and when he got in front of me he flipped the bird . I’m also feeling irritated from an interaction I had with her this morning . I was leaving for work and she stopped me to get me to bring my sister her backpack . My sister is currently at my dad’s and she forgot her school work at my mom’s . I offered to bring the backpack last night but my mom told me not to worry about it , so i’m frustrated that there was a whole song and dance about this simple task that I could have done with no fuss . I miss my girlfriend as well , so I’m sad . They go out with their friends very weekend and I usually get FOMO since I just moved back home and I don’t have a friend group yet , so there’s loneliness in there too .
content , awake , slightly achy , cheerful , anxious
happy , calm , chilled out , na , na
relaxed , excited , well rested , na , na

I am currently feeing a mix of feelings because my birthday is tomorrow and I usually dread my birthday . I am feeling excited for the future but also dreading the amount of emotional labor that will go into my interactions with my family tomorrow . I am also feeling a bit sad that my year did not go as I had hoped .

I am currently feeling a bit tired just because I’ve been at work for the past few hours . I feel content since the store has been mostly empty so I got to read my book . It centered me somewhat , contributing to my mood .

I have been sitting at work and there has not been much to do , so I am a bit tired and my brain feels like mush . I have also been making a lot of small talk and that made me more tired . Overall I feel content .

I created a plan to get a part of my applications done , which made me feel calmer than I did this morning . I also had some nice conversations which made my mood better . I still have some residual stress
